Overview & City Profile

Olten (Olten (BFS 2581)) is a municipality in Bezirk Olten, Solothurn (coordinates 47.3448°N, 7.9001°E; population 18,399). Visitors use Olten as a base to explore Solothurn's historic town centers, regional markets, and culinary specialties such as Cheese fondue, Raclette, Rösti.

Within Solothurn Region (Bezirk Olten region), Olten (Olten (BFS 2581)) serves as a prefectural capital of solothurn region. Travelers exploring Solothurn often combine a stop in Olten with regional highlights such as Historic Altstadt / Old Town, Panoramic mountain & lake views, Marked SwitzerlandMobility hiking trails, Local heritage museum.

Getting to Olten & Getting Around

Via the regional hub (Olten Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)): Connected via hourly SBB CFF FFS rail and PostBus services; fully covered by the Swiss Travel Pass.

  • Local rail & IC cards: Once in Solothurn Region, JR regional lines and local private railways connect Olten with Olten. Nationwide IC cards (Transit Card, Pasmo, Icoca) work on major urban and JR commuter gates; for rural branch lines or local buses, keep CHF 1,000 bills and CHF 100 coins handy for the onboard fare box.
  • Luggage & station lockers: Main stations in Solothurn have coin lockers for day-trippers. If you are stopping in Olten en route between larger bases, check your suitcase dimensions in our Luggage & Locker Checker or forward big bags ahead with Takkyubin.
  • Driving & car rental: While city centers around Olten are accessible by train and taxi, renting a car from a major SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways station or airport in Solothurn can be rewarding for reaching mountain gorges, coastal viewpoints, and countryside onsen. Read our Renting a Car in Switzerland Guide.

Practical Travel Tips for Olten

  • Tourist information center (観光案内所): Look for the Kankō Annaijo counter inside or right outside the main train station in Olten (or at Olten Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)) for free walking maps, bus timetables, and festival calendars.
  • Cash & ATMs: While hotels, chain stores, and convenience stores in Olten accept international cards and IC payment, smaller family-run restaurants, shrines, and rural buses often prefer cash. 7-Eleven (Seven Bank) and Switzerland Post ATMs accept foreign debit cards reliably.
  • Dining hours: Outside major metropolitan hubs, lunch typically runs 11:30 AM–2:00 PM and dinner spots open around 5:30 PM, with earlier last orders (around 8:00–9:00 PM) in smaller cities.

Frequently asked questions

Where is Olten (Olten (BFS 2581)) located in Switzerland?

Olten (Olten (BFS 2581)) is a municipality (gemeinde / commune) located in Solothurn Region in the Bezirk Olten region of Switzerland (coordinates: 47.3448°N, 7.9001°E). It has a population of approximately 18,399 across an area of Regional km².

How do I get to Olten by train?

Most visitors reach Olten via the main prefectural gateway of Olten Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways). Connected via hourly SBB CFF FFS rail and PostBus services; fully covered by the Swiss Travel Pass. From the regional hub, connect by JR local/rapid lines, private commuter railways, or local bus to Olten. You can estimate long-distance rail costs using our SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways Fare Calculator.

What local food is Olten and Solothurn known for?

In Olten and across Solothurn Region, top local dishes include Cheese fondue, Raclette, Rösti, as well as Bircher muesli and Swiss artisanal chocolate. Look for local ekiben (station bento boxes), morning markets, and family-run shokudo near the main station.

When is the best time of year to visit Olten?

Best time to visit Solothurn: Jun–Sep (summer trails), Dec–Mar (winter sports). Check our Switzerland Seasonal Calendar to compare month-by-month weather and crowd levels.
